rows.note: Use 蟋蟀 for the chirping insect; it is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for this sense.

example.english: When I was little, I often caught a cricket in the backyard.
example.traditional: 我細個成日喺後園捉到蟋蟀。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 seng4 jat6 hai2 hau6 jyun4 zuk1 dou2 sik1 seot1

rows.note: Use 板球 for the bat-and-ball sport played between two teams of eleven.

example.english: Not many people play cricket in Hong Kong.
example.traditional: 板球喺香港唔算多人玩。
example.jyutping: baan2 kau4 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 m4 syun3 do1 jan4 waan2
